title: Verifier: a feed plunge deeper than one stepdown into material that the levels above did not cut passes with a centre-cutting tool

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found while working #3453 (issue-worker-high). The coordinator set P1: the verifier passes an unsafe entry silently.

## What happens

A 2D Contour with tabs posts a feed plunge of 18 mm into sheet that no level above cut (#3453, #3678). `verify` gives `ok: true` with no findings.

Evidence:

- The reporter of #3453 ran `verify` on CamCraft v0.25.0 (q07, MDF bracket, 18 mm sheet). The result was `ok: true`, no findings, for a plunge from Z2 to Z-18 with a 2.8 mm crescent of uncut sheet beside the cutter.
- After the #3453 PR, the motion fixture `crates/motion/tests/contour_tab_entry.rs` shows two tab window dives with the full tool disc in uncut stock: Z12 -> Z-18 at (-5.165, -4.266) and (-4.796, 44.676), stepdown 4.5 (#3678 has the tables).
- Code read (context pack of #3453, origin/main 44c13a01d, not changed since v0.25.0):
  - `crates/motion/src/plunge_law.rs:91`: `guard` returns at once for a centre-cutting tool. A centre-cutting tool is the default (`approach.rs:256`, `tool_table.rs:138`).
  - For a tool that is not centre-cutting, the law reads the axis core only (`plunge_law.rs:56`, reach `tool_r * (1 - CORE)`), not the full disc.
  - `crates/sim/src/verify/`: no law compares a feed plunge depth with the stepdown, or with the floor that the cuts before it left under the disc. `rapids.rs` law (d) judges lateral rapids. `contact.rs:117-119` treats a plunge as the entry from air.
  - The wall-side entry notes are advisory (`contour_step.rs:120-127`).

Not verified here: a fresh `verify` run on the current main for the #3453 fixture. The worker ran motion tests only.

## Expected

`verify` names a feed plunge that goes deeper than one stepdown (or a stated limit) below the stock that the earlier cuts left under the full tool disc. The finding blocks the post, or it is a named warning that the user must see. A silent `ok: true` is not permitted.

Done means: a verify test with a recorded program that has such a plunge gives a named finding, and the #3453 catalog case gives the same finding until #3678 is fixed.
